notes.title: Patch Notes 6/6/2022
notes.notes:
EDIT: 6/6/2022 12:27PM
A hotfix has been implemented to resolve a missing crafting table issue, if you're experiencing this update your game and delete your save games (Island and Player saves MUST be deleted together or the game may stop working. Save files are located in the \Acorn City Tropical!\AcornCity\Saved\SaveGames

Version 0.8 has been released


Adjusted Tool Menu
Added Delete Tool
Added Placeholder for Path Tool
Added tutorial
Inventory now saves
Visual improvements
Character Creation
Trees and rocks should now become "empty" and should recharge at 3AM the following day.


If you find any bugs please feel free to post them in our discord server, that's the fastest way to report bugs at this time.

https://discord.gg/zg6Zh2h
